\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 174-177 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R182-first-pass-words-from-chapters-174-177}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for hollow and heavy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item patience, a tear, a laugh, a voice, mind
  \item at last, from now on, still, suddenly, until; while
  \item earlier, every year, now and then, once, twice
  \item far, elsewhere, over there, within, out of doors
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Patience? (\textbf{patientia, patientiae}.) A tear? (\textbf{lacrima, lacrimae}.) A laugh? (\textbf{rīsus, rīsūs}.) A voice? (\textbf{vōx, vōcis}.) Mind? (\textbf{animus, animī}.) At last? (\textbf{tandem}.) From now on? (\textbf{posthāc}.) Still? (\textbf{adhūc}.) Suddenly? (\textbf{subitō}.) Until; while? (\textbf{dōnec}.) Earlier? (\textbf{prius}.) Every year? (\textbf{quotannīs}.) Now and then? (\textbf{nōnnumquam}.) Once? (\textbf{semel}.) Twice? (\textbf{bis}.) Far? (\textbf{longē}.) Elsewhere? (\textbf{alibī}.) Over there? (\textbf{illīc}.) Within? (\textbf{intus}.) Out of doors? (\textbf{forīs}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Therefore? (\textbf{igitur}.) However? (\textbf{tamen}.) Although? (\textbf{quamquam}.) Even if? (\textbf{etsī}.) Unless? (\textbf{nisi}.) Especially? (\textbf{praesertim}.) Rather? (\textbf{potius}.) Most? (\textbf{maximē}.) Very? (\textbf{valdē}.) Quite? (\textbf{admodum}.) Convenient? (\textbf{commodus, commoda, commodum}.) Polite? (\textbf{urbānus, urbāna, urbānum}.) Of the country? (\textbf{rūsticus, rūstica, rūsticum}.) Cheerful? (\textbf{hilaris, hilare}.) Shy? (\textbf{verēcundus, verēcunda, verēcundum}.) Free of charge? (\textbf{grātuītus, grātuīta, grātuītum}.) Fresh? (\textbf{recēns, recentis}.) Raw? (\textbf{crūdus, crūda, crūdum}.) Cooked? (\textbf{coctus, cocta, coctum}.) Distant? (\textbf{longinquus, longinqua, longinquum}.) Public? (\textbf{pūblicus, pūblica, pūblicum}.) Private? (\textbf{prīvātus, prīvāta, prīvātum}.) Common? (\textbf{commūnis, commūne}.) Hollow? (\textbf{inānis, ināne}.) Heavy? (\textbf{gravis, grave}.)
